title: NASA Ignition: CS-8 Task Order 1.0 — survive-the-night performance bonus (radioisotope + transmit after a full lunar night)
note: CS-8 bonus is duration+transmit, not leftover Wh. Hours not printed. 120 h secondary reporting not used. Does not print 5 Wt or 400 W.
quote_bonus: NASA has included a performance bonus for contractors who successfully demonstrate “survive the night” capabilities by deploying a radioisotope device and transmitting signals from the lunar surface after enduring a full lunar night.
quote_readiness: ensuring readiness for deployment by the end of 2028
